context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements cancellation checking with ctx.isCancelled, partial result return, maxRunningTimeSec configuration, and a trigger script that can send CancelTask messages.

checklist.name: Default async handler
checklist.description: Uses export default async function handler with correct typed signature

checklist.name: isCancelled check
checklist.description: Checks ctx.isCancelled or ctx.cancelSignal between processing sections

checklist.name: Partial result on cancel
checklist.description: Returns the partial report generated so far when cancellation is detected

checklist.name: Cancellation note in result
checklist.description: Includes a note in the returned artifact indicating the report was interrupted/incomplete

checklist.name: reportStatus per section
checklist.description: Uses ctx?.reportStatus() to report which section is being generated

checklist.name: maxRunningTimeSec in agent card
checklist.description: agent-card.json includes runtime.maxRunningTimeSec with an appropriate value

checklist.name: Sequential section generation
checklist.description: Generates report sections sequentially with some form of delay or processing between them

checklist.name: Full report on success
checklist.description: Returns the complete report as text/plain artifact when not cancelled

checklist.name: CancelTask in trigger
checklist.description: Trigger script demonstrates sending a CancelTask message to the control channel after a delay

checklist.name: Control channel format
checklist.description: Trigger script uses agent.{agentName}.control for both StartTask and CancelTask
